patterns: Single-fact author/founder questions dominate: Poverty and Un-British Rule = Naoroji (1901), Servants of India Society = Gokhale (1905), Drain theory = Naoroji.
Naoroji traps: first Indian MP (Liberal, 1892), presided INC three times (not four), Swaraj at Calcutta 1906; APPSC 2019 keyed 'founded INC with Hume and Wacha' as wrong.
Andhra tilt: P. Anandacharlu presided Nagpur 1891 (first Telugu president) - asked by APPSC G2 and GS.
UPSC-style multi-statement items appear for economic critics (Naoroji, G. Subramania Iyer, R.C. Dutt) and Indian Parliamentary Committee 1893; Curzon's 'tottering to its fall' quote recurs.
App MCQs go deeper (Welby Commission, British Committee journal, Nyapathi Subbarao titles, theory-matching lists) but are mostly sound; a few are analytical/opinion items unlike APPSC.
